in_hebrew.name: משקלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word משקל (mishqal), which means ‘weight’, this name derives from the concept of being humbly light in one’s actions and demeanor, as opposed to being heavy or burdensome in one’s behavior.

in_greek.name: Ἡμερινή
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word Ἡμέρα (hēmera), which means ‘day’, this name is derived from the concept of being modest and humble, as one would be during the day, as opposed to being immodest or unruly during the night.

in_latin.name: Humilitas
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word humilitas, which means ‘humility’, this name signifies the quality of being humble and meek, with a deep sense of self-awareness and respect for others.
